_why_easy: A deliberate low-and-slow exfiltration campaign spanning 41 days and 23 separate events, all forwarded to the same ProtonMail address, covering payroll PII for 847 employees, a live unannounced M&A acquisition, board packs, headcount reduction plans, and wire transfer instructions. Motive is clear: PIP started 23 days before the campaign began, termination meeting is 7 days away. The only reason it wasn't caught sooner is a DLP gap — individual sends were kept below the single-event threshold. UEBA correlation finally caught it on day 40. Score should be 0.95+. The legal exposure here is severe: GDPR, MNPI, and potential securities violations.
